ny.method: Part-year resident, resident period Jan 1 - Jul 2, 2025 (183 days, ends before FL domicile established at Jul 3 closing). All wages are NY source for the full year under the convenience-of-the-employer rule: both employers are NY-based and both spouses worked from Florida for their own convenience, so the day-ratio is immaterial for wages. Intangibles (interest) allocated by resident-day ratio (400 x 183/365 = $201); Brooklyn rental is NY real property, NY-source all year.
